topLine: Harmonic's Aristotle proves a weaker version of Erdős Problem #124 in Lean.

items.headline: Harmonic's Aristotle proves a weaker version of Erdős Problem #124 in Lean
items.summary: Boris Alexeev reported on the Erdős Problems forum that Harmonic's Aristotle had autonomously proved, with a Lean proof, the first question of Erdős Problem #124, which Erdős had listed as open. Alexeev and Thomas Bloom noted that this is a weaker version of the problem than the one Erdős probably intended. Commenters found the proof surprisingly easy, and the harder version remains open. Searches by Terence Tao with deep-research tools found no prior literature solving it.

sources.name: Xena Project blog (Boris Alexeev guest post)
